The belief that a cause has the approval and protection of the ancestors and territorial spirits.

front: Which medium went with ZANLA into Mozambique in the early 1970s?
In which part of Zimbabwe were the spirit mediums especially important to the war?
What were the mujibhas and chimbwidos?
back: Young helpers who carried messages and supported the fighters.

front: How did mediums help guerrillas gain the trust of villagers?
back: They said the ancestors approved the cause, introduced the fighters and set rules of conduct.

front: Why were songs and pungwe important?
back: They united villagers and fighters and linked the war to Nehanda, Kaguvi and the ancestors.

front: Why should the role of the mediums be judged with balance?
back: People hold different views, accounts differ by area, the war had other causes and civilians suffered.
